paragraphs.text: Innistrad ' s Intro packs provides five preconstructed bicolored decks designed to introduce players to the flavor and mechanics of the Innistrad set. Each deck centers around a specific theme or mechanic, such as Vampires, Morbid abilities, Flashback spells, or Human teamwork, and is paired with a unique combination of two colors to provide a distinct strategic experience. These intro packs not only offer ready-to-play decks for new players but also serve as a foundation for customization, allowing experienced players to expand on the core strategies using additional cards from the set. Each deck comes with a curated mix of creatures, spells, and rares that reflect the dark, gothic horror aesthetic of Innistrad while emphasizing the mechanical identity of the chosen theme.
Carnival of Blood is a black and red intro pack focusing on Vampires .
The rares in this deck are Falkenrath Marauders (holographic foil) and Curse of Stalked Prey .
Deathly Dominion is a black / green intro pack focusing on morbid .
The rares in this deck are Skirsdag High Priest (holographic foil) and Moldgraf Monstrosity .
Eldritch Onslaught is a red / blue intro pack focusing on flashback .
The rares in this deck are Sturmgeist (holographic foil) and Charmbreaker Devils .
Repel the Dark is a green / white intro pack focusing on Humans .
The rares in this deck are Elder of Laurels (holographic foil) and Mentor of the Meek .
Spectral Legions is a white / blue intro pack focusing on Spirits .
The rares in this deck are and Geist-Honored Monk .
